segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Thanks for joining. This is the weekly order review for October the ninth.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Orders are up twelve percent to four thousand two hundred this week, but returns also rose to six percent.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: What is driving the returns? Is it sizing on the new jacket line?

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Yes. Sizing accounts for roughly two thirds of them, mostly the medium and large jackets.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Okay. Leo, please update the size chart on the product pages by Tuesday, October thirteenth.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Will do. I will also email the three hundred customers who returned a jacket with a ten percent voucher.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Good. I will approve the voucher budget of three thousand rupees today. Anything else?

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: One risk. The courier contract renews on October thirty first and their price goes up eight percent.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Let us get two alternative quotes before then. I will take that one. Thanks everyone.
